title: Springpad Pop
creation_method: MusicSaas Gateway game_bgm / SA3 small stereo master; first 64 seconds form the game mix, full single-pass 128-second master forms the station mix; -7 dB gain before AAC encoding. PCM preflight cannot independently prove inference mode or musical quality; human review remains required.
generation_prompt: Original 128-second stereo future bass instrumental at a fixed 142 BPM in 4/4. Begin immediately with a full-energy dance chorus on beat one: syncopated kick, solid snare on two and four, bright hats, rounded sub bass, chopped synth chords and a five-note plucked hook. All elements play continuously for the full 128 seconds, with clear attacks in every bar and near-uniform loudness in every 8-second interval. In the second minute change chord roots and hook notes without ever thinning the texture. Colorful playful family-friendly sound. No intro, breakdown, sparse bridge, riser, outro, fade, silence, vocals, speech, samples, copying or tempo changes.

art_provenance.cover_prompt: Original comic-print cover: three offset rounded square pads connected by a springlike coral zigzag and cyan bounce arcs; no controller, notes, face, character or text. Central graphic readable at thumbnail size.
art_provenance.og_prompt: Horizontal duohertz card with offset spring pads on the right, lowercase title Springpad Pop on left, dark ink, ivory, coral and cyan.
art_provenance.render_method: local macOS sips SVG-to-PNG; source raster equality checked before staging
